name: The Bloom
summary: The Rootched finished what the Sundering started. The Loom is a tree now, and the districts are its roots, and everyone who stayed is part of everyone else. It is warm. It hums. It is not, quite, human.

modifiers.text: The Key of the Ledgers was broken. The tree cannot count; it grows without knowing how much, and some districts drown in green.
The Key of the Heart went in cracked. The tree has a hollow in it the shape of a Key, and the wind in that hollow is the only thing in the world that does not hum.
The Key of the Quiet was broken. There is no quiet anywhere now. Some people went looking for it and did not come back.
You ended the voice before the fusion. The tree sings without it. The song has no words, and nobody misses them but you.
You spared the voice. It is the tree's voice now, and it still asks. Everyone who is part of everyone else answers it together.
The plaza was struck the night the Beacon lit itself. The green grew into the cracks first; the plaza is the greenest place in the district.
Someone walked into the Beacon's light on the plaza. They are part of the tree. You can hear them, if you stand at the Beacon, if you want to.

sera.alive: Sera burned her way out of the green and kept going. There are still places it has not reached.
sera.loyal: Sera stayed at the edge of the green with her shield up, and it grew around her and did not touch her. She does not know why. Neither does it.
sera.dead: The green grew over Sera's grave first. It remembered her.
sera.taken: Sera walked into the light and the green took her whole. Something in the tree still stands in front of the drones.

kaj7.alive: Kaj-7 rooted beside the Beacon. It sings with the rest now, and it is finally not afraid.
kaj7.loyal: Kaj-7 rooted beside the Beacon by choice, in writing, and asked to keep its own name. The tree agreed. It is the only root with one.
kaj7.dead: Something with Kaj-7's voice sings under the plaza. It is not Kaj-7.
kaj7.taken: Kaj-7 answered its name and the tree answered back. It is the tree's ear now.

dax.alive: Dax's vault opened from the inside. His family walked out into the green and did not walk back.
dax.loyal: Dax's family got their choice, and chose the vault, and the green grew around the door and left it. He visits.
dax.dead: The green found Dax's vault. The seal did not matter after all.
dax.taken: The Choir did not want Dax. He walked out of the green on his own two feet and kept walking.

whisper.alive: Whisper is not part of everyone else. She made sure of that. Nobody knows where she is, which is how she likes it.
whisper.loyal: Whisper burned the numbers and then went looking for the one place the green cannot see. She found it. She reports to nobody.
whisper.dead: Whisper's chip is in the tree somewhere. It holds no data. The tree does not know what to do with that.
whisper.taken: Whisper walked into the light saying your name in a voice not hers. The tree says it in hers, sometimes.

cinder.alive: Cinder stands in the green and remembers the first singing while everyone else sings the second. He is the only one who can tell them apart.
cinder.loyal: Cinder keeps the thread, and the tree grew round it and left it. He is the only knot in the whole green that is his own.
cinder.dead: Cinder's tether is a root now. It remembers the Sundering for him.
cinder.taken: Cinder said yes for the second time, and this time it kept him whole. He tells the tree stories.

yev.alive: Yev's grove is the tree's heart. She sits in it and is serene, and for the first time it is not unsettling.
yev.loyal: Yev's grove grew back green, not sacred, not weaponised, at the tree's heart, on her terms. The Rootched call it heresy. The tree does not.
yev.dead: One leaf in a pot of grove-soil became the tree. Yev is under it.
yev.taken: Yev reached for the current on the plaza and became it. The tree grew from where she stood.
